# Getting Support for CodePilot AI

Thank you for using **CodePilot AI**! We are committed to fostering a helpful and welcoming developer community.

---

## 1. Where to Ask Questions

Depending on the nature of your inquiry, here is the best place to ask:

### 💡 General Questions, Architecture & Design Discussions
* **GitHub Discussions**: Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/v-ani-2006/code-review-agent/discussions) to ask questions, share project ideas, discuss architecture patterns, or showcase your CodePilot AI integrations.
* **Topic Categories**:
  * *Q&A*: Ask technical questions about using the API or SDK.
  * *Ideas*: Suggest new static rules, language parsers, or prompt engineering improvements.
  * *Show and Tell*: Share how you deploy CodePilot AI in your organization or CI/CD pipelines.

### 🐛 Bug Reports
* If you believe you have discovered a bug in the application, please search existing issues first.
* If no existing issue covers your bug, open a new issue using our [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/v-ani-2006/code-review-agent/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).

### 🚀 Feature Requests
* Have an idea for a new feature, language parser, or generator? Submit a proposal via our [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/v-ani-2006/code-review-agent/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).

### 🛡️ Security Vulnerabilities
* For confidential security vulnerability reports, please refer to our [Security Policy](file:///c:/Users/VANI/OneDrive/Documents/Desktop/code-review-agent/.github/SECURITY.md) and do **not** post details publicly.

---

## 2. Before Opening a Question

To get the fastest answer, please:
1. Review the [Documentation Guide](file:///c:/Users/VANI/OneDrive/Documents/Desktop/code-review-agent/docs/development-guide.md).
2. Check the [API Reference](file:///c:/Users/VANI/OneDrive/Documents/Desktop/code-review-agent/docs/api-reference.md) and [Troubleshooting Guide](file:///c:/Users/VANI/OneDrive/Documents/Desktop/code-review-agent/docs/troubleshooting.md).
3. Search [Closed GitHub Issues](https://github.com/v-ani-2006/code-review-agent/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed) for similar problems.

---

## 3. Community Standards

All interactions in our issue tracker, discussions, and pull requests are governed by our [Code of Conduct](file:///c:/Users/VANI/OneDrive/Documents/Desktop/code-review-agent/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Please be respectful and supportive of fellow developers!
